WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date
  FROM fact_web_order
),
l AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, s.store_id, p.category,
         wd.dispatch_date, wd.status,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN wd.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS bdate
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-20' AND DATE '2026-08-20'
)
SELECT CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web' WHEN store_id=999 THEN '999' ELSE 'store' END AS kind,
       staff_purchase_flag, category='ZZ Test' AS is_test,
       status,
       count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(net_amount) AS net,
       sum(CASE WHEN bdate BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN net_amount END) AS net_in_range,
       count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bdate BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN receipt_id END) AS rec_in_range,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE bdate IS NULL) AS null_bdate
FROM l GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

calls.statement:
WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
l AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, COALESCE(wd.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS bdate, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT store_id, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS rec, sum(net_amount) AS net FROM l
  WHERE bdate BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(receipts) AS rec, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) AS store_id, m.rec AS my_rec, c.rec AS ctl_rec, m.net AS my_net, c.net AS ctl_net, m.net-c.net AS net_diff, m.rec-c.rec AS rec_diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE m.net IS NULL OR c.net IS NULL OR abs(m.net-c.net)>0.005 OR m.rec<>c.rec
ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, s.store_id,
           CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE l.store_id < 900) AS store_receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE l.store_id < 900) / COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE l.store_id < 900), 2) AS atv_stores_only,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE l.store_id = 900) / COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE l.store_id = 900), 2) AS atv_web_only,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE l.store_id = 900) AS web_receipts,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (l.store_id, l.receipt_id)) AS store_receipt_pairs
FROM lines l
WHERE NOT l.staff_purchase_flag
  AND l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
